context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the security-review-process instructions from the published Ruby Core Skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Verify every parameter is explicitly allowlisted and type-coerced if necessary.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Verify no raw SQL strings are built via string interpolation (`#{}`).

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Avoid dynamic shell commands via backticks, `system()`, or `exec()`. If necessary, pass arguments as separate array items.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Verify sensitive data (passwords, tokens, personal identifiers) is filtered/redacted from log output.
